title: Opta HQ becomes self-updating

highlights.text: Signed & notarized — HQ is now a Developer-ID app with hardened runtime
The Opta Update System arrives: silent background updates with a quiet 'Restart to update' pill — never a forced restart
Loadout-driven sidebar (Atlas substrate): foundational pins + your installed modules, replacing the two-tier nav
Brain round 2: zen mode, resizable rail, region rails, People cards

notesMarkdown: First release shipped through the Opta Update System. From this version forward, HQ updates itself: hotfixes install silently and wait for your next restart; feature releases like this one announce themselves properly.

modules.summary: Zen mode · rail resize · region rails · People cards
